title: A posteriori error estimates for the two-step explicit exponential Adams method for parabolic equations
summary: In this paper, we derive optimal order a posteriori error estimates for the variable step-size explicit two-step exponential Adams (E-Adams2) method for parabolic problems. We begin by introducing an E-Adams2 approximation, deffned by the piecewise linear approximate solutions, which leads to suboptimal error estimates.
